verdict.rationale: Bulk operations are a fair axis for a hardware-key product, for example mass enrollment, fleet configuration, or credential replacement. The evidence pack documents no capability that acts on many items at once. ykman offers per-device scriptable management, and the YubiEnterprise REST API covers fleet delivery, inventory and shipments, but neither is described as performing bulk actions. Looping a script over devices would be a user-side workaround or developer building block, which earns no credit. Community reports confirm users must replace keys account-by-account manually.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
